Position Classification: Registered Nurse
Remuneration: 81748.17 - 114771.98
Hours Per Week: 38
Requisition ID: REQ677495
Located in: Westmead
Applications Close: Midnight on 22 July 2026
For role related queries or questions contact Sean Pay on Sean.Pay@health.nsw.gov.au

At the Sydney Children's Hospitals Network, every role helps children and young people live their healthiest lives.

As the largest paediatric health service in Australia, we care for thousands of children each year, in hospital and at home. Our people are united by compassion, collaboration and excellence in care.

An exciting opportunity exists for a Registered Nurse to join the SCHN virtualKIDS service. virtualKIDS is a dynamic, multidisciplinary service offering on site 24-7 specialty paediatric virtual care to children and young people, both locally and throughout NSW. The aim of our service is to ensure children and their families have access to the right health care, at the right time and in the comfort of their own home. We offer support for children and young people with acute conditions, as well as chronic and complex health care needs. - Recent Acute Paediatric experience with an up-to-date skill set is essential. - Good clinical IT skills are essential. - Experience in Virtual care platforms is not essential, training will be provided. This role currently requires candidates to work a rotational roster across seven days, including day, afternoon and potentially night shifts. The role is based onsite and may require work across both The Children's Hospital at Westmead and Sydney Children's Hospital, Randwick. The service is currently undergoing consultation regarding a proposed 10-hour shift model.

Additional Benefits (where applicable): Flexible work opportunities, Salary packaging and meal entertainment benefits, accrued days off (ADOs), fitness passport, employee assistance program (EAP)

How to Apply:
Click 'Apply Online' and submit your application including:

A resume (maximum 5 pages) outlining your experience

Responses to the questions below:

Current Authority to Practice as a Registered Nurse with the Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (AHPRA).

Demonstrated excellent verbal, written and interpersonal skills.

Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary team.

Current Acute Nursing experience in a hospital setting.

Effective time management skills.

Computer literacy.

Capacity to work a seven (7) day rotating roster including public holidays.

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 

 

Child Safe Standards:
SCHN is committed to maintaining a child-safe environment that respects and upholds the rights of children and young people, in line with NSW Health's commitment to the Child Safe Standards. We aim to ensure that children and young people feel safe, supported, and included in their care. All current and prospective staff are expected to prioritise the safety, welfare, and well-being of children and young people, actively working to protect them from harm and abuse.

Additional Information:

SCHN is an Equal Opportunity Employer that values diversity, recognising that a diverse workforce strengthens our culture and enhances the care we provide to children, young people and their families.

Permanent NSW Health roles require Australian citizenship or permanent residency. Temporary visa holders may be considered where no suitable Australian citizen or permanent resident is identified.

NSW Health vaccination and screening requirements must be met prior to commencement.

This position requires a Working with Children Check (WWCC) issued by the Office of the Children's Guardian.

Where required, overseas qualifications must be formally assessed by the Department of Education or relevant authority for recognition in Australia.

An Eligibility List may be created for future temporary full or part time vacancies

Assertiv is an IT Security company specialising in Identity related solutions, support, training and managed services. We are currently looking for a talented IDAM Security Engineer with a background in designing, developing, implementing and supporting Identity Security solutions.

We are seeking candidates who possess good technical knowledge and experience with Opentext NetIQ Identity Governance, Silverfort Identity Security Platform, Microsoft Entra ID and related technologies and are willing to do the hard yards when it comes to delivering successful outcomes for our customers. In return, we will provide you with training across a variety of products, on-site (or remote) customer experience, and the support of a great team to help you further develop your skills and experience in IT Security.

Role Description

This role will engage in workforce and customer Identity related projects and undertake the following project-based activities:

· Install and configure Workforce and Customer Identity products.

· Install and configure Identity Security products including ISPM and ITDR.

· Develop integrations between Identity systems and business applications, specifically onboarding applications to Identity Governance systems.

· Conduct functional testing and undertake code fixes as required.

· Assist with System, Integration, Performance and User Acceptance Testing.

· Assist with documentation (Solution Design, Test Cases, Deployment Guides, As-built documents).

· Develop drivers and connectors for connected applications.

· Design and implement single sign-on using open standards (OAuth, OpenID Connect, SAML, WS-FED).

· Design and implement advanced authentication processes (Multi-Factor, Risk Based Auth).

· Assist with handover and/or training to customer BAU/Operations teams.

· Provide ongoing solution support for customer implementations.


We are looking for candidates with the following attributes and experience:

· University graduated, with coursework around software development, computer networks, and web development.

· Two or more years of professional work experience with Workforce and/or Customer Identity related products such as NetIQ, Silverfort, Ping Identity, and Microsoft Entra.

· Experience with developing, implementing, and configuring complex IT Security solutions.

· Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

· Security concepts and principles (e.g. knowledge of SAML and OAuth).

· Strong programming and scripting skills (Java, PowerShell, JavaScript, Bash, etc.).

· Networking technologies and concepts (TCP/IP, DNS, routing, switching, firewalls).

· Virtualisation, Citrix, VMware.

· Cloud computing – AWS, Azure, Google, and hybrid environments.

· Windows Server/Active Directory/ADFS

· Linux (Red hat and/or SUSE), IOS, Android.


We are a focused team with highly experienced staff, a great offering, and you will be part of a growing team with a fun and positive culture. Whatever your goals, there will be plenty of room for career advancement as we grow. Remuneration will be commensurate with skills and experience. If this is the opportunity you have been waiting for, then we want to hear from you! Your resume will be assessed by our team, and if we feel that you could be a good fit, we will be in touch regarding the next steps.
